jobs.title: Is Lightning HOTTER Than the Sun? 🌀 #Swirlverse
jobs.description:
Is lightning really hotter than the Sun? It depends! A lightning bolt can heat the air to about 27,000°C, about 5 times hotter than the Sun's surface (about 5,500°C). But the Sun's core is about 15 million °C, over 500 times hotter than lightning. And in this parallel world, lightning is only as hot as a candle flame... ⚡
Hot lightning or calm lightning? Comment below 👇

Real science: lightning superheats a narrow channel of air so fast that it expands with a bang, and that sound wave is thunder. The 27,000°C figure is a peak; parts of the channel are cooler. Sources: NOAA National Weather Service, NOAA NSSL, NASA, Britannica.
